# Fumble

> Free, client-side D&D 2024 toolkit and Obsidian-powered campaign wiki. No login, backend, analytics, or advertising.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://fumble.krystianpinczak.com/): Product overview and tools
- [Compendium](https://fumble.krystianpinczak.com/compendium): Spells, items, creatures, classes, rules, and other D&D content
- [Books](https://fumble.krystianpinczak.com/books): Indexed D&D books and adventures
- [Campaign wiki](https://fumble.krystianpinczak.com/wiki): Public campaign reference
- [DM tools](https://fumble.krystianpinczak.com/dm/encounter): Encounter, initiative, loot, and soundboard tools
- [Full machine-readable index](https://fumble.krystianpinczak.com/llms-full.txt): Every public canonical page with a concise description
